verifiedScope.proxy: Lifetime original-Portuguese novel first-book-publication span, from Terra do Pecado to Caim, used as a publishing proxy rather than a claim of uninterrupted writing. The six selected markers use Portuguese first-edition years, not composition, serialization, later translations or adaptations; English titles are supplied for readability. The first novel appeared in 1947 as Terra do Pecado after the publisher changed Saramago’s proposed title A Viúva (The Widow). The long gap before his later novels is part of this publishing span, not evidence of continuous novel production. Claraboia (Skylight) was completed in 1953 but first published posthumously in 2011. The unfinished Alabardas, alabardas, Espingardas, espingardas followed posthumously in 2014; neither extends the lifetime bar. Poetry, plays, short stories, chronicles, journalism, translation work, diaries, memoirs and nonfiction are outside this novel-only scope.
